title: Describe support coverage and optional context without personal balance targets

source.ref: Daniel's support/practice/expression changeover; final surface survey found primary-only adopted counts and equal-Zap author warnings.

detail: Implementation keeps the getMemberPillarBalance array API while reusing LIVE-2288's authored support helper, grouping adopted practices by ID and counting each known support once per practice. Member and feed surfaces name current adopted support counts, explain overlap, and remove normalized share/ideal-progress bars; they do not treat adoption as performed practice days or wellbeing. The existing historical Zap reader, data attributes, totals, unattributed amount, anonymous omission and incomplete-history warning remain intact. The admin view retains the unchanged pillarZapBalance bookkeeping function and reward values but describes primary-category per-log sums without equality success/deficiency warnings or daily quotas. Its pure math and all existing tests/probes remain unchanged. The immutable consequence probe executes the actual reader and renderers with inert dependencies: on dependency branch LIVE-2288 head07364b512 the legacy reader returns [2,0,0,0] for a duplicated four-support practice; implementation returns [1,1,1,1]. It also verifies anonymous omission, original ledger values and descriptive admin/member units. Dependency LIVE-2288 must land before this one-row feature PR. No SQL, reflection storage, analytics, rewards, flags or historical data changed. Local focused tests and lint pass; synthetic actual member/admin/feed states render at 390,1280,1440,1920,2000 without horizontal overflow. Fixtures do not prove authenticated or production acceptance. Root and independent discovery-peer reviews completed. The peer found a projection gap: the actual getMemberPractices read omitted the existing secondary column. Its optional Practice field and shared explicit select now carry that column; generated table/view types and the existing ranked-view migration confirm availability without SQL. Three new projection-aware regressions follow the actual member reader into coverage while returning only requested fields. Root also required a generic incomplete-reward warning even when a failed read loads zero Zaps; that warning is now visible outside the nonzero branch. Final 70 focused tests across ten files and changed-file ESLint across ten TS/TSX files pass. The unchanged exact SCAN-502 guard remains at its 150-export cap. The required backlog passes 2685 entries with 992 agreeing probes. Its first run caught one new low-contrast tiny-type style; the admin explanation now uses the existing larger text-meta/text-muted tokens, with the adoption ratchet, affected tests and renders passing without any baseline change. Exact-head CI, preview and real acceptance remain release gates. November14 continuation: dependency LIVE-2288 is now merged on main69a6c5af5. The final surface conversion changes only optional-support guidance in standard Circle callouts, Circle manifest/member/admin editors and structured tool field descriptions, plus descriptive primary-category labels on public Journey path counts and a learner soft warning that permits continuing without logging. Existing field paths, required flags, schema/output shapes, save/actions, reward calculations and stored widget key pillar-balance remain unchanged. A new immutable support-surface-guidance probe executes actual templates, manifest and tool/config metadata with inert model dependencies; after completing its loader before freezing, it fails on current main at the actual compulsory four-area callout and passes on the converted surfaces. Five new tests exercise actual optional metadata and a real CircleBuilder rendering that retains only the authored Body note, leaves three fields empty and never saves on render. Current-container verification passes 89 focused tests across 12 files, including unchanged legacy reward-attribution/discovery/coaching/page-config tests, and all20 changed TS/TSX files pass ESLint. Synthetic actual CircleBuilder, TemplateEditor and PillarBalanceBlock render acceptance and final backlog verification are recorded separately after completion; production/authenticated acceptance is not claimed by source or fixture checks. Final extension renders: 15 actual component fixtures (CircleBuilder with real standard callouts, TemplateEditor and public PillarBalanceBlock at five required widths) pass overflow and unnamed-button checks; the mobile Circle, template and public path screenshots were visually reviewed. Fixtures use synthetic data/inert actions and do not prove authenticated or production acceptance. Root and independent policy/picker reviewers found no product blocker. Final current-main release candidate check:backlog passes with2690 entries and997 agreeing probes. No original tests/probes/pins, reward amounts, budget caps or threshold values were changed; the new extension probe is frozen at SHA256298ab4881a7af3f7b2c76ee254b40b5d4cf306d66c6a87ecd608c9b2ab6cc85c and original coverage probe remains5a038d23e4d9614d1c0903b4400271b56b949ad925631b88bf40bf64eba46c1a.
